component.name: CleanMate
component.summary: Free up space and keep Ubuntu tidy
Giải phóng dung lượng và giữ Ubuntu gọn gàng

description.p: CleanMate finds what is taking up space on your computer and lets you remove it safely — caches, old logs, leftovers from removed packages, developer and AI tool caches, and more. Nothing is deleted until you have seen the list and confirmed.

ul.li: Smart Scan checks more than fifty places at once and shows one checklist with sizes
System junk: package cache, unused packages, extra old kernels, old Snap revisions
Logs: systemd journal, rotated and oversized logs, crash reports, old app logs
Every browser and app cache as its own choice
AI tools: caches and old chat sessions of Claude, Codex, Gemini, Zed and others
Developer junk: npm, pip, Go, Cargo and Docker leftovers, idle node_modules
Privacy: browser history and cookies, terminal history, recent files and other histories

description.p: It uses the system's own tools wherever possible (apt, journalctl, snap, docker), keeps a fallback kernel, never touches logins, keys or settings, and asks for your password only for system items. A terminal version with even more tools is included: run cm.

screenshot.caption: Smart Scan finds junk everywhere and shows one checklist with sizes
See exactly what will be removed before anything is deleted
Check what is inside every item
Clean caches and old sessions of AI coding tools
Find large and old files and move them to the Trash, with undo
Uninstall apt, Snap and Flatpak apps with the folders they leave behind
See what takes up space, folder by folder, and move what you don't need to the Trash
Find duplicate files and keep the oldest copy of each
Choose which apps, services and timers start when you log in
Settings: automatic cleaning, update check and what cleaning leaves alone
The same engine in the terminal: run cm

description.p: New cleaning items, a first-run welcome, and faster Smart Scan.

ul.li: GPU shader cache and desktop search index (Tracker, Baloo) items
Uninstaller: reset an app, AppImage apps, leftovers of removed apps
Privacy: browser history, downloads list and cookies
Developer Junk: old Android SDK parts and old editor extensions
Broken startup items, low disk alert and scan reminder, Report a Bug
Faster Smart Scan on computers with many projects or packages

description.p: First public release of CleanMate for Linux.
